messages.author: a5e83218c834e013
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Is estimation in an SDE possible?
parts:
The problem with SDEs is that, unlike ODEs, they are not deterministic 
so you can’t “solve” them in the same way that you can an ODE.  Instead
you have to marginalize over all possible SDE solutions, or paths, to get
a valid answer.  In theory this requires dealing with an infinite dimensional
space which is not feasible in Stan, but there are many approximations.
For example, you can discretize time and hence the path, treating it 
similarly to a hidden Markov model or an autoregressive time series.
This is similar to what Dominic mentions in the slides, and is how INLA
approximates SDEs, too.
